description: Na₂V₂NiH₄(OF)₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one O and six F atoms. The Na-O bond length is 2.90 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.48 Å. V is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two O and four F atoms. There is one shorter (1.66 Å) and one longer (1.69 Å) V-O bond length. There are a spread of V-F bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.21 Å. Ni is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.10 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Ni and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one V and one Ni atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one Ni atom. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one V atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two equivalent Na and one V atom. In the third F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent V atoms to form edge-sharing FNa₂V₂ tetrahedra.
